catalogNotes: Pluto remains in the source catalog: its generated identity is wired and its current effect is unchanged.
Two draw-bag states and three reveal overlays are included as prepared assets; main has no matching draw-bag interface, so no new mechanic was invented.
All pack families have sealed/open art; Arcana sealed reuses the existing illustration.
All 24 live Omens have unique art: 23 new images plus the existing Double Omen. The initial 350-image delivery omission is corrected.
Omen artwork is separate from edition layers and Omen Lens (a Charter). Current Omen acquisition and gameplay are unchanged; a future Skip removal needs a separate acquisition redesign.
No new Riichi Decree portrait or TableLoop-specific artwork was generated or added.
